summary.en: Vector graphics editor whose Microsoft Store package includes an arm64 build.
summary.zh-TW: 向量繪圖軟體，Microsoft Store 套件內含 arm64 版本。

caveats.en: The Store manifest gives no version number. Linaro's catalog lists native 1.3.2.0 and an NVIDIA validation, but the Linaro result was not independently read for RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: Store 資訊未標示版本號。Linaro 目錄列為原生 1.3.2.0 並有 NVIDIA 驗證，但未另行確認 RTX Spark 的結果。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

evidence.title: Microsoft Store package manifest: Inkscape (arm64, x64, x86)
